metadata.title: Longitudinal Empirical Dataset: Global and Regional (Pakistan) Software Engineering Labor Market (2020-2026)

institutional_sources.name: Stack Overflow Annual Developer Surveys
institutional_sources.scope: AI tool adoption, developer roles, framework usage

institutional_sources.name: Stanford Institute for Human-Centered Artificial Intelligence (HAI)
institutional_sources.scope: AI Index Reports, technical benchmarks (HumanEval, SWE-bench)

institutional_sources.name: State Bank of Pakistan (SBP)
institutional_sources.scope: Telecommunication, Computer and Information Services Export Receipts (FY20-FY26)

institutional_sources.name: Pakistan Software Houses Association (P@SHA)
institutional_sources.scope: Annual IT Industry Reports, Salary Surveys, and Export House Breakdown

institutional_sources.name: US Bureau of Labor Statistics (BLS) & CompTIA

eras.name: Pre-GenAI Era (Up to 2022)
eras.characteristics: High volume intake, ZIRP-fueled expansion, manual syntax execution, standard apprenticeship pipelines

eras.name: Disruption & Contraction Era (2023-2024)
eras.characteristics: Copilot/ChatGPT emergence, tech layoffs, junior developer squeeze, remote offshore realignment

eras.name: Intelligent Agentic Era (2025-2026+)
eras.characteristics: Autonomous coding agents, SWE-bench saturation, systems verification dominance, human-in-the-loop architecture

skills_lifecycle_dynamics.replacement_vector: AI Agent Code Generators (Cursor, Claude, Copilot)
skills_lifecycle_dynamics.primary_evidence: Stack Overflow 2024 Developer Survey (AI code gen usage); Peng et al. (GitHub Copilot 55.8% speedup)

skills_lifecycle_dynamics.replacement_vector: Autonomous synthetic test generators & AI verification agents
skills_lifecycle_dynamics.primary_evidence: P@SHA 2024 Talent Report (Manual QA hiring drops by 61%); IEEE Software 2025 on Automated Test Synthesis

skills_lifecycle_dynamics.skill_domain: Single-Framework Web Dev (Pure Frontend without Systems)
skills_lifecycle_dynamics.replacement_vector: Generative UI, component frameworks, automated design-to-code
skills_lifecycle_dynamics.primary_evidence: Stack Overflow 2024-2025 (Full-stack developer titles outnumber pure frontend by 3.4x)

skills_lifecycle_dynamics.replacement_vector: Human architect supervises AI, owns end-to-end delivery
skills_lifecycle_dynamics.primary_evidence: P@SHA 2025 Tech Job Postings (React/Node and Python backend make up 61% of software house requirements)

skills_lifecycle_dynamics.replacement_vector: Human validates AI hallucination boundaries and security
skills_lifecycle_dynamics.primary_evidence: DORA State of DevOps 2024; ACM Transactions on Software Engineering 2025 on AI code verification

skills_lifecycle_dynamics.skill_domain: AI Orchestration (RAG, Vector DBs, Agent Workflows, Evals)
skills_lifecycle_dynamics.primary_evidence: Stanford HAI AI Index 2025 Enterprise Adoption; GitHub Octoverse 2024 (GenAI OSS repo growth +140%)

skills_lifecycle_dynamics.market_status: Uncompromised Screening Standard (Big Tech & Elite R&D)
skills_lifecycle_dynamics.replacement_vector: Required to evaluate AI-generated code performance and correctness
skills_lifecycle_dynamics.primary_evidence: Levels.fyi Interview Benchmark 2025; Google/Meta/OpenAI Software Engineer Interview Guidelines

pakistan_market_breakdown_2026.sources: P@SHA Annual IT Industry Report 2025; State Bank of Pakistan FY25/FY26 Data

fresh_grad_supply_vs_intake.sources: Higher Education Commission (HEC) Pakistan Annual Report; P@SHA Talent Survey 2025
top_rejection_reasons_hiring_managers: Zero deployed projects / unverified code claims (68%)
Tutorial-level knowledge without deep debugging ability (62%)
Inability to write tests or explain architectural choices (54%)
Lack of Git hygiene and CI/CD awareness (46%)
Resume listing 10+ disjointed skills with 0 depth (41%)
